entries.heading: INCREASED TERM LIMIT FOR INTERGOVERNMENTAL SUPPORT AGREEMENTS TO PROVIDE INSTALLATION SUPPORT SERVICES
ancestors: Subtitle B—Real Property and Facilities Administration
entries.text:
SEC. 2813. INCREASED TERM LIMIT FOR INTERGOVERNMENTAL SUPPORT 
                          AGREEMENTS TO PROVIDE INSTALLATION 
                          SUPPORT SERVICES.

    Section 2679(a)(2)(A) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``five years'' and inserting ``ten years''.
